facts.fact: The World Bank's ID4D diagnostic states that the Ministry of Education and Sports plans to use national identification numbers as the primary identifiers of pupils and students and so establish a functional register of learners, linked to EMIS, to track transfers, drop-out and fresh enrolment and to weed out ghost learners; the plan is undated, so the publication date is used.

systems.tiers: planned in 2018; pupils and students in schools, identified by NIN
12.5 million identities (learners and teaching staff); used for educational planning and capitation grants

systems.system: learner register link to the National Identification Register
systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Sports with NIRA

note: Passages only. The learner register is a stated plan of 2018, not a system in use; the diagnostic does not say what schools enter in EMIS itself.
